reviews.text: Hier wird anscheinend Mawlid gefeiert und an eine irregeleitete Aqeedah (Glaubenslehre) von den Personen der religiösen Neuerungen geglaubt, anstatt an die Aqeedah die auch die 4 Imame und die Sahaba des Propheten ‎ﷺ hatten (keiner von ihnen feierte jemals Mawlid, noch ihre Schüler oder Söhne und Töchter).
reviews.textTranslated: Here, it seems that Mawlid is being celebrated and a misguided Aqeedah (doctrine) is being believed by the people of religious innovations, instead of the Aqeedah that the 4 Imams and the Sahaba of the Prophet ‎ﷺ had (none of them ever celebrated Mawlid, nor their students or sons and daughters).

reviews.name: Walid Alrahmo
reviews.text: مكان عبادة رائع ومريح يوجد مصلى للنساء يوجد طهارة ووضوء يوجد خشوع بالمسجد القائمين على المسجد رائعين ومتواضعين توجد صالة للمناسبات بأسعار رمزية الخطبة بثلاث لغات وهذا امر جيد العربية الكردية الالمانية ، الحقيقة كم تمنيت ان اذهب دأما الى هذا المسجد وأودي صلواتي فيه الا سكني بعيد جدا عن المسجد وقد عرفته بمحض الصدفة ؟
reviews.textTranslated: A wonderful and comfortable place of worship. There is a prayer area for women. There is purification and ablution. There is a sense of devotion in the mosque. The people in charge of the mosque are wonderful and humble. There is a hall for events at symbolic prices. The sermon is in three languages, which is a good thing: Arabic, Kurdish, and German. In truth, how much I wished to always go to this mosque and perform my prayers in it, but my residence is very far from the mosque, and I only found out about it by pure chance.

reviews.text: Beautiful 😍 relaxing place,

reviews.textTranslated:
A beautiful, quiet, spacious, and clean place. I thank those responsible for cleaning for their great efforts, and I also commend the association that oversees the mosque, from the highest to the lowest ranks, for their good work. May God reward you and bless you.

A beautiful, quiet, spacious, and clean place. Many thanks to all those who maintain cleanliness, as well as to the association that manages the mosque. May God reward you.

reviews.name: AB
reviews.text: Die Moschee liegt nahe dem Stadtzentrum. Der Gebetsraum befindet sich im ersten Stock und bietet auch einen Waschraum. Der Imam des Freitagsgebets spricht Arabisch. Es gibt einen zweiten Stock für Männer und einen für Frauen. Die Moschee ist renovierungsbedürftig. Ich lade meine Brüder ein, beim Bau des Gotteshauses zu helfen, und ihr werdet, Inschallah, das Paradies haben.
reviews.textTranslated: The mosque is located near the city center. The prayer hall is on the first floor and also includes a washing room. The imam for Friday prayers speaks Arabic. There is a second floor for men and one for women. The mosque is in need of renovation. I invite my brothers to help with the construction of this house of worship, and you will, God willing, have paradise.

reviews.name: Maung Pu Naing
reviews.text: One of the most modest prayer places in Wuppertal.... Taqwa

reviews.text: مسجد جميل لقد اتيت من مدينة كيل زيارة وصليت في هذا المسجد الجميل، اسمه مسجد عثمان،
reviews.textTranslated: A beautiful mosque. I came from the city of Kiel for a visit and prayed in this beautiful mosque, its name is the Osman Mosque.

reviews.name: Sabr
reviews.text:
As selamu aleykum wa Rahmetullahi wa barakatu
Eines der schönsten Eindruck hatte ich gestern zu juma MaschaaAllah dieser İmam es war nicht nur Balsam für die Seele dort beten zu dürfen, sondern auch ein Genuss diese Stimme diese recitation MaschaaAllah.
Schade ist das dort der Klimaanlagen entweder nicht funktionieren oder ich verstehe nicht wieso man diese nicht in Betrieb setzt, dafür zieh ein Stern ab.
reviews.textTranslated:
As-selamu aleykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.

One of the most beautiful impressions I had yesterday was this Imam during Juma Masha'Allah. It was not only balm for the soul to be able to pray there, but also a delight to hear his voice and recitation, Masha'Allah.

It's a shame that the air conditioning either doesn't work or I don't understand why it isn't turned on; I'm deducting one star for that.

reviews.name: Rshad K
reviews.text: Salam alykum ich hoffe ihr schreibt die richtige Öffnungszeit. Ich bin extra hingefahren, um zu beten aber leider ist zu
reviews.textTranslated: Salam alykum, I hope you're posting the correct opening hours. I drove there specifically to pray, but unfortunately it's closed.
